dedupe_keys.name: per capita water consumption in saudi regions

description: Per Capita Water Consumption In Saudi Regions is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contain p er capita water consumption In Saudi regions during the period 2009-2018. Data from General Authority for Statistics. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. The Per Capita Average Daily Use Of Water Is Calculated As Follows: Total quantity consumed by municipal sector (liter)/population365. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal files it under Water & Agriculture. Its keywords are Water Consumption. The portal shows 2024-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
